**💡 Today's learning: "Natural" means safe**
- 🤔 **What people believe:** A label that says "natural" or "herbal" means the product can't hurt you.
- 🔬 **The fact:** The US National Institutes of Health (NCCIH) says "natural" medicines are not without side effects: the herb kava may be linked to severe liver damage, and ephedra to heart problems and death. The US FDA also has no power to approve supplements for safety before they go on sale.
- 🎯 **How they fool you:** "Natural" is a feel-good word with no safety test behind it; sellers use it so you skip the doubts you'd have about a pill. Read the ingredients, and ask a doctor if you take other medicines.
- Source: https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/know-science/natural-doesnt-mean-better
